services.value: Provides environmental microbiology testing services including bacterial testing (e.g., Aerobic Spore Count, Legionella, Coliform, Rapid E. Coli, Enterococci), pathogen testing (e.g., Cryptosporidium and Giardia), MPA testing, microplastics testing, and virus testing (e.g., EPA Method 1615 coliphages, Enteric Virus Detection, Human Adenovirus, Total Culturable Virus Assay, BFMS Virus Kit). Also offers consulting and device/method validation studies, plus sample analysis and reports.
